headline: Public hearing on a new off-premise wine and malt beverage license for KP Market at 49 John Fitch Hwy.
summary: Applications for a taxi driver, Sunday brunch hours at Partner's Pub, and a restaurant license for all alcoholic beverages at Kate's Golden Spoon are also listed. The agenda also includes a joint municipal complaint about child labor and wage violations at Xochimilico Mexican Cuisine.
